subject: Private deployment next steps — architecture deep-dive availability & pre-read
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment next steps — architecture deep-dive availability & pre-read

Thanks for taking time today, Jordan — great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can scope the Private/VPC runbook for Helix Health Systems:

- Priority goals you gave: keep PHI traffic inside VPC, key management via your KMS (bring-your-own), and predictable latency for inference during daytime clinic hours (08:00–18:00 local).
- Key constraints: single VPC peering (no transit VPC), maintenance window only on Saturdays 02:00–06:00 local, and SOC2 audit next quarter.

Next step: architecture deep-dive (60 minutes) with your infra and our private deployment team to go over networking, IAM mapping, and ops runbook. Connor will lead the technical portion from Redwood.

Proposed slots (all US/PST):
- Thu Oct 22, 10:00–11:00
- Fri Oct 23, 14:00–15:00

Attached: redwood-priv-deploy-checklist.pdf (short checklist we use to collect access/network requirements). Also linking a short pre-read where you can drop any existing network diagrams: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-pre-read

Could you confirm which slot works and include Priya from procurement if procurement needs to join? If neither works, drop 2–3 windows that do and we’ll slot in.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

—
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@helixhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment next steps — architecture deep-dive availability & pre-read

Thanks, Naomi — useful recap. Fri Oct 23 14:00–15:00 PST works best for our infra lead (and keeps us outside the Saturday window). I’ve looped Priya (procurement) so she can confirm whether procurement needs to attend the kickoff or just receive the MOP and contract summary afterwards.

A few clarifications for the deep-dive:
- We can provide a VPC peering connection; we will not allow cross-account shared subnets.
- For KMS, Helix prefers a customer-managed key with rotation policy; we may need guidance on how Redwood references an external KMS for encryption at rest.
- We will send a current network diagram and a list of permitted egress IP ranges by EOD Thursday.

Jordan
Director, Infrastructure
Helix Health Systems
jordan.lee@helixhealth.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment next steps — architecture deep-dive availability & pre-read

Perfect — I’ve penciled Fri Oct 23 14:00–15:00 PST. Connor, can you join that slot? Connor: high-level ask from Helix (Jordan) is VPC peering only, customer-managed KMS accessibility, and a short ops runbook showing maintenance/failover behavior.

Jordan/Priya — attaching a preliminary network snapshot that Helix shared earlier (helix-network-snapshot.png) and our checklist again. For the call prep, would you be able to drop the following into the shared Drive pre-read folder before the call?
- current VPC CIDR + peering account ID
- list of egress IP ranges to allow
- outline of KMS requirements (key ARN and rotation policy)

If procurement prefers not to attend, we can loop them into the post-call note and the contract MOP. Priya — feel free to flag if you want to be on the call; otherwise we’ll follow up.

Calendar invite: I’ll send once Connor confirms. Also note: we will prepare a short runbook excerpt about our private deploy rollback steps and a list of required IAM roles.

—
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment next steps — architecture deep-dive availability & pre-read

I’m on for Fri Oct 23 14:00–15:00 PST — will bring a short slide deck covering: network/topology options, KMS integration patterns (BYO KMS flow + key policy examples), and our suggested maintenance/rollback checklist.

Prep notes for Jordan: if you can share hostnames (or expected FQDNs) and whether you need mutual TLS for the peering, I’ll add exact firewall rules to the runbook. If you expect specific audit-log pushes to your SIEM, let me know which events you need (auth, inference request/response meta, agent lifecycle events).

See you Friday.

—
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
